keyPhrases.text: There's really only one reason to see
The problems with both play and production arrive
Saunders is such a marvel that none of this really matters

reasoning: Mixed review with strong praise for Saunders' performance but significant criticisms of the production's pacing, other performances, and directorial choices. The critic acknowledges problems but suggests the lead performance makes it worthwhile, indicating a qualified recommendation typical of 3-star territory.
